providers.market_view: The German equity market (DAX) is currently navigating a period of technical consolidation near all-time highs as the Q3 2026 earnings season approaches. Investor sentiment is supported by a significant upward revision in the German government's 2026 growth forecast (from 0.5% to 1.3%) and stabilizing interest rate expectations following softer global labor data. Near-term momentum is concentrated in the aerospace, defense, and financials sectors, driven by structural demand and strategic buyback programs, while technology and consumer discretionary sectors face selective rotation ahead of major October earnings reports.
